metadata.description: Free, open-source Claude Code skills and plugins by Bubble Invest — the Bubble shop for agentic workflows.

plugins.name: telegram-reporter
plugins.description: Send Telegram messages from any script or cron via curl. Reads a bot token from a config file.

plugins.name: notion-linker
plugins.description: Automatically link published content (articles, posts) back to project rows in a Notion database.

plugins.name: generate-image
plugins.description: Generate images locally with FLUX.2 Klein via mflux, on an Apple Silicon Mac. Free, offline, no API calls.

plugins.name: notion-reader
plugins.description: Query a Notion database or page from any script. Reads a token from config; DB/page IDs via env vars.

plugins.name: voice-transcribe
plugins.description: Transcribe voice notes / audio files to text locally and offline (whisper.cpp, no API key) — Telegram .oga, wav, mp3, flac. FR/EN/auto.

plugins.name: longform-video
plugins.description: Turn an article into a 1-5 min narrated landscape video essay: Remotion + local TTS voice cloning + Pexels b-roll + kinetic typography. Fully local voice, no cloud TTS.

plugins.name: source-verification
plugins.description: Source-tier classification + independent-verification rubric for any external signal before you act on it. Tier gating, corroboration math, paywall discipline. Not investment advice.

plugins.name: thesis-format
plugins.description: A canonical 7-part investment thesis structure (claim, mechanism, fit, invalidation, sizing, asymmetry, conviction levers) that renders at three depths: reference file, memo, chat. Not investment advice.

plugins.name: publish-substack
plugins.description: Publish or schedule ONE approved Substack Note or Post on your own account, in your own visible browser, after your explicit yes. Publishing only, stops at the first refusal.

plugins.name: local-tts
plugins.description: Local text-to-speech (VoxCPM2, 30 languages, cloning your own voice or that of someone who consents). Free, offline, Apple Silicon.

plugins.name: prospect-research
plugins.description: Build or refresh a structured Research Capsule for any sales prospect: background, workflow pain points, recent signals, and three outreach angles (V1/V2/V3). Writes a local Markdown file. Read-only on social sources — never sends or posts anything.
